name: ai on your terms
headline: *AI*, on your terms
say: A.I. agents now act for people almost everywhere. In Hypercomb, an agent speaks the same sentences you do, under the same rules. You choose the model: one in the cloud with your own key, or one that runs on your own machine. It reads only what you allow, and proposes what to change. Inside your hive, history can undo anything it does, and anything that would leave your device waits for you to accept it.
